copy.headline: Voters will likely decide Dallas City Hall’s future in May election
copy.caption: Voters will likely decide Dallas City Hall’s future in May election. Organizers with the Save Dallas City Hall Coalition submitted roughly 35,000 petition signatures to the city, aiming to let voters decide the historic building's fate in a May election.
